brief.headline: Realign GLS Films' laminate pricing to our best-in-class rate of ₹290.00/KG and recover ₹3.91 L annual excess, while their severe financial distress and multiple compliance red flags demand strict volume limits and an active second source.

priceAsk.summary: Match our best laminate price of ₹290.00/KG across all SKUs, starting with the top three items currently at ₹295.00/KG.
priceAsk.target: ₹290.00/KG (our best price from Shrinath Roto Pack Pvt Ltd), closing the 1.7% gap and recovering ₹3.91 L annually.
priceAsk.basis: We already pay ₹290.00/KG to Shrinath Roto Pack Pvt Ltd for identical laminate specs. GLS Films charges ₹295.00/KG on key SKUs (LM ELECTRAL MD 21.80g LS 07, LM ELECTRAL UD 4.4g LS 05, LM ELECTRAL MD 21.80g LS 08), creating a 1.7% premium with no quality differentiation. Market import benchmark for BOPET film sits at 171.60 ₹/kg, giving ample conversion margin at ₹290.00/KG.

paymentTermAsk.summary: No change to current 30 Days After Receipt terms; do not extend credit given their distress.
paymentTermAsk.cashImpact: Maintaining 30-day terms protects ₹18.97 L in working capital. Any extension to 45 days would tie up an additional ₹9.49 L we cannot afford to risk with a loss-making, over-leveraged supplier.

brief.financialLeverage: GLS Films is in severe financial distress: net margin of -3.4% versus peer median of 2.5%, posting a loss in FY2024-25, with catastrophic interest coverage of 0.06x and high leverage at 2.15x debt-to-equity. Probe42 scores them 2/10 with a D health rating (21/100), flagging loss-making status, severe legal cases, GST filing delays, EPF payment delays, and high leverage. Their IVR BBB- / Stable rating is mid-tier at best. Our ₹2.31 Cr spend represents just 0.33% of their ₹691.05 Cr revenue, so we have zero commercial clout and significant supply-continuity risk. Push hard on price to match our proven ₹290.00/KG benchmark, but do not demand payment-term extensions that could tip them into default. Qualify Huhtamaki, UFLEX, or Constantia Parikh immediately as second sources and cap GLS volume until their financial picture stabilizes.

evidence.point: We overpay GLS Films by ₹3.91 L annually versus our own best laminate price
evidence.figure: ₹3.91 L total estimated annual excess vs best price we pay

evidence.point: GLS charges ₹295.00/KG on our top laminate SKU while Shrinath delivers identical spec at ₹290.00/KG
evidence.figure: LM ELECTRAL MD 21.80g LS 07: our price ₹295.00/KG, best price ₹290.00/KG from Shrinath Roto Pack Pvt Ltd, gap 1.7%, excess ₹3.35 L

evidence.point: GLS Films is loss-making with a negative net margin well below peers
Their interest coverage is critically low, signaling imminent debt-servicing stress
GLS already stretches its own supplier payments far beyond peer norms
evidence.figure: Their payable days 53d vs peer median 36d

evidence.point: Our commercial leverage is negligible—we are a rounding error in their revenue
evidence.figure: Our spend as share of their revenue 0.33%

alternates.name: Huhtamaki India Ltd
alternates.why: Listed flexible-packaging converter already in our supply base, proven and scalable for laminate sachets with B health rating—immediate second source.

alternates.name: UFLEX Ltd
alternates.why: Listed flexibles giant covering both film substrate and conversion, can second-source laminates at scale.

alternates.name: Constantia Parikh Packaging Pvt Ltd
alternates.why: Global Constantia group's India converter specializing in pharma blister and sachet laminates, strong second-source fit for our Electral SKUs.

risks: GLS Films' Probe42 financial score of 2/10 and D health rating (21/100) signal high supply-disruption risk—do not concentrate volume here.
Loss-making status in FY2024-25 (net margin -3.4%, PAT ₹-23.68 Cr reported in precomputed levers) means aggressive price cuts could trigger supply failure mid-contract.
Multiple compliance red flags (severe legal cases, GST filing delays, EPF payment delays) indicate operational and regulatory instability.
Debt-to-equity of 2.15x and interest coverage of 0.06x point to imminent refinancing or restructuring risk—qualify alternates before next PO cycle.
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We value the partnership, but we need to talk about alignment: we're paying you ₹295.00/KG for laminates we source elsewhere at ₹290.00/KG, and with your current financial position we need that gap closed and a clear plan to de-risk our supply.
